text: Consistent 'Transfer & Pay' hub across web and app with tile IA (Transfer money & pay Truist accounts | Pay bills | Send Money with Zelle®) and exact screen names documented in an official QRG [S006].

Zelle depth: scheduled/recurring with 7-day reminders, QR send/receive, Zelle Tag and 'View my QR code' for business, in-app 'Cancel This Payment' when recipient unenrolled, explicit pay-yourself scam education [S001][S011].
Consumer Bill Pay contractually supports Instant Payments over RTP and responses to biller Request for Payment; Truist ran the industry's first alias-based RfP pilot (Apr 2025) [S014][S049].

Digital wire origination for Wealth/Premier personal and all small-business accounts with per-wire OTP, no callbacks, future-dating; wholesale wires via token in Treasury Manager/Digital Treasury [S014][S017][S057].
Real-time credential-based verification of external accounts (app 4.6.0, Oct 2025) and agreement allowing Next-Day and Instant external transfers [S009][S014].
Truist Assist can execute internal transfers and Truist bill payments conversationally with live-agent handoff [S004].

Commercial: One View SSO with Digital Treasury (ACH/wire/RTP), Treasury Manager (ACH file dual approval, template dual approval), Integrated Payables, and One View Connect ERP-embedded information reporting (public guide Rev. 04/26) with in-ERP RTP payments and approvals announced in the Oct 2025 pilot [S023][S045][S033].[S955]
Fee-based Immediate Availability for mobile/ATM check deposits (monetized instant funds) [S037][S015].

Small-business Online Banking offers an optional in-product Dual Approval Feature for both ACH and wires (Approver designated by the Business Profile Owner; 'Secondary Approval'; pending status), on top of per-transaction one-time passcodes and two-phone transaction validation [S906].

Consumer External Transfers tier now contractually includes Instant Transfers over the RTP network ('or another third-party instant payment network'), 24/7 incl. weekends, with in-app display of eligible speeds, cut-offs and limits per account and a contract status model pending → in process → complete [S907].

Commercial Digital Treasury has a documented end-to-end payment workflow with explicit status taxonomy (Entered → Approved → Released → Bank Received → Bank Confirmed; Incomplete Approval; High Value secondary approval), 8 extraction windows a day, approval alerts, and RTP-specific alerts ('Incoming Real Time Payment Transaction', 'Payment Request Received') [S912][S913][S914].

Mobile deposit guidance is complete and public (endorsement 'For deposit only at Truist', one check per deposit, limits on the Deposits tab, ineligible items, 10-business-day retention, per-transaction Immediate Availability disclosure) [S902].
No FedNow participation as of Nov 2025 (Banking Dive) and Oct 2026 third-party list — RTP only [S032][S055].
Zelle/ACH/wire claims are phone-only; Dispute Tracker covers cards; three different phone numbers for Zelle issues, claims and status [S021][S001].

External transfers: default 3 business days and fee-bearing outbound ($3 standard, $6 next-day, $3 instant from Oct 2026) where most peers are free; business accounts excluded from External Transfers [S014][S057].
Online wire origination for consumers is limited to Truist Wealth and Premier relationships; mass-market consumers must wire in branch or by phone ($30/$65 assisted) [S057][S056].
Business Zelle receive fee (1% capped $15) where peers are free [S011][S015].
No documented dynamic scam interstitial for Zelle or wires; wire security relies on OTP without callbacks [S014][S017].
Bill Pay stop-payment is phone/mail only with 5-business-day lead; expedited payments irrevocable [S014].
Community reports of long deposit holds and Zelle payment holds requiring lengthy calls [S054].

Scam-claim intake remains phone-only ('call the Truist Care Center immediately ... to file a claim'); no in-app or web scam/Zelle claim form; still no dynamic scam interstitial evidenced [S904][S907].

No dedicated Bill Pay, external-transfer or help-center landing pages (/online-banking/bill-pay and /help-center fail); FAQs are reachable only through truist.com site search (Zelle 39, mobile deposit 18, bill pay 10 results) and there is no external-transfer FAQ; key rules live in the service agreements [S901][S902][S905][S952].

Retention guidance is inconsistent: FAQ says destroy the check 'ten business days after your deposit is confirmed' while the agreement says retain at least 7 calendar days then destroy/VOID [S902][S907].
Disbursements with Zelle for commercial clients is a file/MFT-based service (CSV/pipe files, control totals, secure-email summary report) rather than an interactive portal experience [S915].
Truist still absent from the FedNow live-participant list as of Nov 2, 2026 (BofA, TD, Fifth Third also absent) [S920].
First bank to send/receive alias-based Request for Payment via RTP (Apr 2025 internal pilot) [S049].
Zelle Tag + printable QR for small-business collections [S011].
One View Connect: embedded banking inside NetSuite, Sage Intacct, Workday, Dynamics 365 BC with Koxa (pilot Oct 2025) [S033].
Immediate Availability fee option on mobile and ATM check deposits [S037].
Truist Assist natural-language money movement [S004].
$100 Balance Buffer on Truist One Checking (not a payment product but shapes overdraft exceptions) [S012].
Digital Treasury 'Beneficiary Notification' emails up to five addresses when a wire is confirmed by the bank, and 'Fraud and Risk Decisioning in the Mobile App' QRG for One View mobile [S913][S910].
Apr 25 2025: alias-based RfP bill pay pilot over RTP [S049].
Oct 22 2025: One View Connect embedded-ERP pilot [S033].
Nov 2025: Truist still not on FedNow (Banking Dive) [S032].
Feb 2026: Mastercard open-banking integration (first); AI-enabled Integrated Receivables launch (PYMNTS headlines) [S052].
Service agreement update eff. 4/8/2026 and change summary eff. 9/17/2026: instant-payment handling on closed accounts, SMS program rename [S014][S016].
October 2026: 'Instant transfer to your accounts at other financial institutions' ($3) begins per personal fee schedule [S057].

App releases (App Store): 3.2.0 Jul 26 2024 device widgets (Zelle, transfers, check deposit); 3.4.0 Nov 14 2024 Security Center checklist, external-account linking from home, recurring bill-pay/Zelle insights; 4.0.0 Feb 26 2025 Truist Assist everywhere, add card to device digital wallet, bill-pay payee groupings, Plan & Track; 4.4.0 Aug 14 2025 improved bill-payment activity/confirmations and external-account verification; 4.5.0 Sep 10 2025 payee-list cleanup; 4.6.0 Oct 27 2025 Assist search, 24-month deposit history, real-time external-account verification; 4.7.0 Dec 4 2025 security-settings navigation; 5.1.0 Feb 12 2026 multi-payee bill payments; 5.3.0 Apr 14 2026 new ways to pay using account and routing number; 5.4.0 May 7 2026 five saved User IDs; 5.5.0 Jun 25 2026 clearer mobile-deposit guidance, Siri balances; 5.9.0 Oct 28 2026 24-month credit-card history and streamlined check deposit [S919].
Treasury Resource Center (Nov 2026) lists Truist One View Connect as a standard Platform with a public user guide (pilot announced Oct 2025) [S916].
ISO 20022: Fedwire incoming/outgoing implemented July 2025; SWIFT outgoing ISO Nov 2025; structured addresses Nov 2026 [S918].
FedNow participant list updated 11/02/26 still excludes Truist [S920].
Aug 2025: electronic direct deposit switching (Atomic) embedded in digital account opening; 19% of digital applicants who used it completed a switch (Zacks, Dec 2025) [S954].
Sep 17 2026: new versions of the personal and business Online & Mobile Banking service agreements; business agreement adds an 'Approver Admin' role to the Dual Approval Feature [S952][S953].
Exact Zelle/wire/external limits and whether a dynamic scam interstitial exists.
Status/GA of alias-based RfP consumer bill pay and of One View Connect.
Exact in-UI label for the Instant Payment (RTP) option inside Bill Pay — still unevidenced (contract name 'Instant Payment Bill Pay Service'; no FAQ, no screenshots).
Whether an eBill 'auto-pay' toggle exists — agreement has no automatic-payment clause; only 'choose your payment frequency'.
Status of Treasury Manager (SunView) — absent from the Treasury Resource Center Platforms menu; may be retired/merged into Digital Treasury.
What the 5.3.0 'new ways to pay using your account and routing number' feature is (pay-by-bank at merchants? bill-pay by account?).

Current currency options for small-business international wires in Online Banking: 2022 transition doc says USD only; 2026 agreement reserves bank conversion to local currency; fee schedule lists online international $35. Needs a current OLB form screenshot/help text (TFC-C015).

Treasury Manager (ex-SunView) status: absent from Treasury Resource Center 'Platforms' (One View, Digital Treasury, One View Connect) as of Nov 6 2026; evidence for J17/J18 Treasury Manager steps dates from 2022. Needs a Truist retirement/migration notice or current guide (TFC-C016).
Whether One View Connect in-ERP RTP payments and approvals (announced Oct 2025 pilot) are generally available; the public user guide Rev. 04/26 covers information reporting only (TFC-C011).
